Title: Anil and the Family

Cast

1. Anil - 30 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Meenakshi - 57 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Karan - 34 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Sunita - 32 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
5. Anita - 26 years, daughter
Look: green saree

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Anil stands on the road. Meenakshi, Sunita and Anita stand near him.]

Anil: "Today feels like a good day."

[Anil starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Sunita (happily): "Anil, listen!"

[Anil is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Anil: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
